name: obj_emit_static
notes: AL = object index, AH != 0 -> O table (DS:E54C), else T tables (DS:E7E0 < 40h, DS:E770 >= 40h); 4-byte header; transforms (75c1), emits faces (7487) and sprite children into DS:9A73/9CF3/9F73/A1F3

name: world_build_visible
notes: per-tile loop over the map (DS:9671): road tile via 72f8, then placed static objects of that tile via 72f8

name: obj_emit_vehicle
notes: BX = object slot; 8-byte header, far LOD (bytes 4-7) when DX > 200h; caches transformed vertex/face ranges

name: obj_emit_vehicle_moving
notes: like 539d for moving objects; reuses cached vertices shifted by DS:BCC4/BCC6/BCC8 when unchanged

name: obj_transform_verts
notes: transform DS:946B vertices at SI (A/B/C arrays) into DS:2502 (height), DS:3182, DS:3E02; sets DS:BD22 on vertex-buffer overflow (630h)

name: vert_rotate
notes: read A=[si], B=[si+bx], C=[si+2bx]; rotate B/C by heading DS:946A (sin/cos DS:B851/B7CF), shear A by DS:BD38; returns DX:AX

name: obj_emit_faces
notes: copy CX-DS:BD24 faces to 10-byte records at DS:E5B8 (4 words + vertex base DS:945E, colour codes -> pixel pair via DS:E5B0, DS:B4B9, DS:B6B9)

name: obj_face_runtime_colours
notes: face types 20h-60h: lamp/brake/siren/traffic-light colours; 68h: animate vertices 0,1 from 12-byte frames (wipers)

name: obj_runtime_colours_all
notes: calls 4db6 for the emitted objects

name: vehicle_collisions
notes: pairwise test of moving objects with the collision boxes of their models

name: vehicle_collision_boxes
notes: test one object's collision boxes (8 bytes: A,B,C,r,h) against DS:BCC4/BCC6/BCC8; sets DS:946C bits

name: path_tile_lookup
notes: SI = map cell: heading -> DS:946A, lane-path list of the tile type in P set (DS:CE9E) -> DS:BCB8 / DS:946D

name: traffic_follow_path
notes: advance a traffic object along its P-set waypoints (8 bytes: flags, h, x, z)

name: faces_sort_keys
notes: per face record: depth = average (or max if w0 bit 13) of vertex depths DS:6382

name: draw_faces_and_sprites
notes: draw sorted face records (DS:BAB1 = colour pair, DS:BA9A = face type) and sprite children

name: draw_face_dispatch
notes: w0 bits 14-15: point 3bba / line 3c0c / triangle 3a91 / quad 3b0e

name: draw_point
notes: point size DS:95D9[w0 bits 11-12] scaled by depth; w0 bit 13 = one-sided

name: fill_spans
notes: span filler into the RAM page (ES = DS:90D0); colour word byte-swapped on alternate rows (dither); OR mode when DS:BA9A == row>>7

name: build_colour_remap
notes: fill DS:E5B0[32] colour-code remap (day/night DS:95C7, weather DS:BC75/BC77)

name: draw_sprite_child
notes: scaled sprite for a tile child (DS:9A73 entry)

name: stage_load_objects
notes: loads <scene>T.BIN -> DS:E770, O.BIN -> DS:E54C and P.BIN -> DS:CE9E when DS:0B15 = 0, car .POB -> DS:CEA4, opponents' .POB -> DS:CEBC / DS:D7A4

name: load_opponent_pob_nonvga
notes: non-VGA only: reload opponent .POB into DS:CEBC

name: o_set_ptr
notes: O object set (SCENETTO.BIN): u16 offset[64] + objects

name: p_set_ptr
notes: P lane-path set (SCENETTP.BIN): u16 offset[123] + (count, 8-byte waypoints)

name: t_shared_ptr
notes: SCENETTT.BIN road tiles (tile types < 40h)

name: t_scene_ptr
notes: <scene>T.BIN road tiles (tile types >= 40h)

name: player_pob_ptr
notes: player car .POB (object types 0,1)

name: opp1_pob
notes: opponent car .POB (object type 2)

name: opp2_pob
notes: opponent car .POB (object type 3)

name: scene_has_own_op
notes: nonzero: <scene>O.BIN / P.BIN not loaded (shared SCENETT sets used)

name: colour_remap_ptr
notes: 32-byte colour-code remap table (0e12:261c)

name: colour_pair_table
notes: (c2<<4|c1) -> pixel pair; from leg <scene>A..E.DAT offset 1F27h (file loaded at DS:9592)

name: colour_direct_table
notes: codes 16-31 -> pixel; leg .DAT offset 2127h

name: face_records_ptr
notes: emitted face records, 10 bytes: w0..w3 (+vertex base), colour pair

name: vertex_base
notes: first transformed-vertex slot of the current object

name: obj_heading
notes: object heading: bits 0-5 fine angle, 6-7 quarter turn

name: obj_vertex_count
notes: vertices left to transform

name: face_alias_skip
notes: faces dropped for aliased T entries (< 11h)

name: cur_object_ptr
notes: object being emitted by 72f8

name: obj_pos_x
notes: position (A5B9 units); vertices add it <<2

name: obj_pos_z
notes: position (A6F9 units)

name: obj_pos_h
notes: altitude added to vertex A

name: obj_pitch_shift
notes: height shear shift in 7653

name: face_type_cur
notes: w3 >> 8 & F8h of the face being drawn

name: face_colour_cur
notes: pixel pair of the face being drawn

name: vert_h
notes: transformed vertex heights

name: vert_x
notes: transformed vertex x

name: vert_z
notes: transformed vertex z
